items.html: And now the matter of the four Mochin of ZA, which are the inheritance and the two coronets, has been explained in brief. However, to expand this discourse we must explain the secret of the Tefillin; and in order to explain them we must understand the words of the article mentioned in Idra de Haazinu, page 292b, and this is its language: "In the cavities of the skull three lights shine. And if you say three, they are four, as I say: the inheritance of his father and his mother, and the two hidden ones of them, which crown all of them on his head, and they are the Tefillin of the head. Afterwards they are joined in his sides and shine, and enter into the three cavities of the skull," etc., until the end of its words.
